effects.label: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the buff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This buff can be stacked.

bio: You'd think pirates would be more grateful for their medical care, but Mazzen finds few of her patients thank her for her doctoring. It could be due to all her magic rats, but more likely it's because she keeps experimenting on anyone trapped in her care. Still, is a little gratitude too much to ask?
